purpose: Record a later plan-review regression, its retained reproducer, and a bounded correction to generated technical dependency edges.
finding: The first revocation implementation passed its earlier checks but a subsequent 14-case plan-review run produced seven errors. Multiple typed fields may reference the same dependency. Calling codec.strings on the generated combined edge list incorrectly treated this shared dependency as an invalid duplicate request.
correction: Only generated traversal-edge handling changed: require a list with at most 256 entries before deduplication, apply the existing bounded nonempty text validator to every entry, then deduplicate with dict.fromkeys. Existing public request validation and codec.strings are unchanged.
authority_assessment: This is ordinary graph traversal correction within D083/REQ-008. It changes neither scientific meaning nor package identity, revocation authority, provenance propagation or admission rules.
